beats.label: The comparison
beats.text: A review pooled **24** studies of **1,238** healthy adults and tracked **bone-building** blood markers.

beats.label: Walking & jogging
beats.text: Low or moderate effort showed **no meaningful** long-term effect on those markers.

beats.label: Football & handball
beats.text: Fast **sprints, jumps** and **turns** were linked to marker rises of up to **46%.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: These are **blood markers,** not bone **density** or **fractures.** Don't quit walking or lifting.

beats.label: Before you sprint
beats.text: Build up **slowly.** With **osteoporosis** or a heart condition, ask your **doctor** first.
Follow for the **fine print** behind fitness headlines.
